result.summary: Found several visual issues: truncated restaurant names, a nonsensical discount badge, and a partially cut-off category chip.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you section, making the full name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Ensure restaurant name text wraps to two lines, uses a smaller font, or truncates with an ellipsis while preserving readability of the full name on tap/detail.

issues.description: The pizza card shows a '-100%' badge, which looks broken or incorrect as a discount label (implies free or data error).
issues.suggestion: Verify promo/discount data; display a sensible label such as '100% off', 'Free', or the actual discount, and hide the badge if the value is invalid.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip ('Healthy') is clipped by the screen edge with no clear affordance that more categories exist beyond the visible row.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent peek/padding for the horizontal chip scroller or a fade/scroll indicator so users know the row is scrollable.

issues.description: Delivery fee and metadata text under restaurant cards uses very light gray, which may reduce readability especially on non-retina or bright displays.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast of secondary text (delivery time/fee) to meet WCAG AA contrast ratios against the white background.
